case_number: 2025 INSC 298; CIVIL APPEAL NOS. OF 2025 (Arising out of SLP(C) Nos.14513-14514 of 2020)
summary: Land dispute over occupancy rights; Karnataka Land Reforms Act, 1961; improper unilateral modification of court order via 'for being spoken to'; violation of natural justice; oral mention for correction after 3 years invalid; Supertech precedent on judicial finality; High Court clarification upheld; appeal dismissed.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment affirmed; unilateral modification of order set aside.
